items.title: Smarter cut plans in Birdhouse
items.text: The Sheets tab now packs boards so every saw cut runs edge to edge, numbers the cuts in order, shows the offcuts worth keeping, and lets you set the saw cut, edge trim and grain direction. Save the offcuts to your Workshop so the next plan uses them first.

items.title: Build steps and a timeline in Birdhouse
items.text: A new Steps tab turns a plan into build steps with how long each takes, shows glue and finish drying as waiting time, and gives a ready-to-use date from your start day and hours a day. Tick steps off, pick a finish, and see which tools you still need to find.
